purpose: Read-only file search hand — recursively lists and greps local files under an allowed root. No writes, no shell mutation, no credentials.
inputContract: A DelegationBrief: objective naming a search root + pattern; allowedActions subset of this hand's allowedActions; falsifiable expectedResult.
abortPolicy: On timeout, abortHandTask moves task to blocked — never silently verified. Read-only; no rollback needed.
escalationCondition: Objective implies write/mutation/credential access -> escalate to ceo.
